name: Melo
fix_description: In mint, the function is public without any access control. Anyone can mint arbitrary amounts of tokens to any address. Fix: add onlyOwner or onlyMinter modifier to restrict who can call mint.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward missing access control issue: the attacker directly calls an unrestricted mint function, then swaps the freshly minted tokens for USDT. The PoC is very short, involves essentially two actions, and requires minimal protocol-specific or DeFi-specific reasoning.
